caseName: Spears v. State Board of Medical Examiners
caseNameFull: Leo L. Spears v. The State Board of Medical Examiners of the State of Colorado
attorneys: Mr. Albert L.-Y oye, with whom Mr. Carle Whitehead was on the brief, for plaintiff in error. Messrs. Wm. L. Boatright and Charles H. Haines were on the brief for defendant in error.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for want of a substantial Federal question on the authority of Shulthis v. McDougal, 225 U. S. 561, 569; Hull v. Burr, 234 U. S. 712, 720; Norton v. Whiteside, 239 U. S. 144, 147.
